note: The capability map. Each block on the about page names a set of pieces that evidence it, and the build recomputes the words, figures and tables of that set on every run rather than storing them. A piece may evidence more than one capability, so the sets are not a partition of the corpus and their subtotals do not add to it. Which pieces evidence which capability is a reading, not a measurement: the membership is declared here so a reader can disagree with it, and the build checks only that every slug is a listed piece and that no capability is left empty. There are no levels and no self-ratings anywhere in this file, because neither could be checked.
